segments.sn17.38-43:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.38-43:1.3: Idhāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi –
segments.sn17.38-43:1.4: ‘na cāyamāyasmā pitupi hetu … pe … bhātupi hetu … bhaginiyāpi hetu … puttassapi hetu … dhītuyāpi hetu … pajāpatiyāpi hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyā’ti.
segments.sn17.38-43:1.11: Tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
segments.sn17.38-43:1.12: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.38-43:1.14: ‘uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma, na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī’ti.
segments.sn17.38-43:2.1: Bhindi mūlaṃ duve dhammā, pakkantaṃ ratha mātari;
segments.sn17.38-43:2.3: Pitā bhātā ca bhaginī, putto dhītā pajāpatīti.
